item.text:
“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”

“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier and R-OK here.]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary gives a $1 million daily maximum; “keeps” implies the amount is unchanged.]

“who's support” >>> “whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 members.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided. The later descriptions of Kowalski and Ames also need reconciliation with this list.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“a seperate interview” >>> “a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“occured” >>> “occurred”

“hearing on the impacts of deep-sea mining occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: The votes section dates the hearing to September 23; confirm whether these are different hearings or an incorrect date.]

“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary specifies 18 months, not two years. Confirm whether Section 6 requires negotiations to conclude or merely directs negotiation within that period.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“to there senators” >>> “to their senators”

“recieve updated notes” >>> “receive updated notes”

“Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: The coverage plan previously says there are six Hill reporters.]
